info.title: Pulse Verity Index
info.description: Read signed crypto index prices, discover covered assets, retrieve recorded prints, and verify price receipts through five read-only MCP tools.

post.description: Sends JSON-RPC 2.0 messages to the Pulse Verity Index over Streamable HTTP while the client negotiates the MCP session and discovers tools at runtime.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Requests the JSON and event-stream response formats used by Streamable HTTP.

200.description: The server accepted the MCP request and returned a JSON or event-stream response.

401.description: The Authorization header was missing or its bearer credential was refused.

405.description: The endpoint received an unsupported HTTP method.

500.description: The server could not complete the MCP request.

tags.name: Pulse Verity Index
tags.description: Provides read-only access to signed Pulse Verity Index observations.
